verdict.rationale: LlamaParse's Index product offers a hosted vector-search/embedding pipeline (docs-19, docs-30, docs-31) and structured JSON/table extraction with page-level provenance (docs-15, docs-22), suggesting some RAG-ready segmentation, but the evidence never documents explicit semantic chunk boundaries or embedding-ready segment metadata as a first-class output of Parse itself, and a community question about even basic page-number metadata in markdown output (llamaparse-comm-7) went unanswered, indicating gaps in chunk-level metadata support. missing for 10: explicit chunking/boundary strategy documentation, embedding-ready segment schema, confirmed page/metadata tagging in default output.
